tasks.task: Lay out a flyer, postcard or handout

items.when: When a printed piece has a deadline and you need the steps and approval points in order
When the brief and copy are approved and you need size, grid, type and bleed written out
Before you settle a layout, to get three hand-made alternatives to the template look
When the piece carries a lot of text and needs a grid, a short type list and white space
When a layout is drafted, to see where the eye lands first, what to move and what to cut

tasks.task: Make a carousel or a set of social posts

items.when: When you need exact sizes, type, safe areas and slide-by-slide text for each post
When the client has no slide text yet and needs each card's words and picture planned
Before you settle a slide layout, to get three hand-made alternatives
When every slide looks like a stock template and nothing would stop a thumb
Before posting, to check the words read on a phone and sit inside the safe area
When the client's team will build and reuse the slides themselves

tasks.task: Design an event poster

items.when: Before layout, to find the one idea, one feeling and one symbol the poster should carry
When you have the event details and want a guided run to a layout and an export checklist
When there are no usable photos, to try a type-only poster that reads from far away
When the client wants to see a finished art-style poster fast and it carries few words
When the poster is a collage of everything and needs one bold symbol
Before sign-off, to check type size for the viewing distance and the colour contrast

tasks.task: Turn a thin request into a brief and copy deck

items.when: When a client says "can you do us a flyer?" and nothing about the job is written down
When the client sets no limits, to fix firm rules for the piece before any layout
When the client cannot describe the look, to pin down tone and feel in four answers
When the client shares designs they like, to turn them into colours, type and feel you can reuse

tasks.task: Build a reusable social template kit

items.when: Before the templates, to fix the colour, type and grid rules every post must follow
When the brand has no clear look, to compare three mood board directions first
When you spec each template's size, type styles and safe areas for the client's team
When someone else will build the templates in Canva or a similar tool
When the kit is drafted, to find where the templates drift from the brand's look and voice

tasks.task: Lay out a printed menu or a menu board

items.when: When you have every item and price and need sections, order and what to feature
When the menu plan is agreed and the printer needs exact size, type and bleed
When dish descriptions are vague, to make each one short, true and easy to picture
When a crowded menu needs a strict grid so names, notes and prices line up
When the menu is drafted, to check type size, spacing and line length where it is read

tasks.task: Plan event signs and wayfinding

items.when: Before the sign list, to map every point where a first-time visitor must choose a way
When you need one schedule of every sign, its words, size and place for the printer
When guests have access needs, to plan step-free routes and what the venue must confirm
When signs must be read at a glance by people who are walking and unsure
Before printing, to check letter height for the reading distance and the contrast

tasks.task: Lay out a banner, roll-up stand or shop sign

items.when: Before layout, to cut the message to one line a passer-by takes in
When you need the large-format size, safe area, type sizes and file set-up written out
When the sign is read from across a street, to try a type-only version
Before sign-off, to check the main line reads from the real viewing distance

tasks.task: Spec business cards and stationery

items.when: When the client has no brand fonts, to compare three font pairs with sizes
When you need card size, margins, type sizes and bleed for the printer's template
Just before the order, to catch small type, thin lines and wrong bleed

tasks.task: Spec merch for shirts, totes, caps and stickers

items.when: Before ordering, to turn a design idea into a spec the printer can produce
When the client wants stickers, to draft a set of characters from their logo
When an illustrator will draw the artwork and needs a clear brief
When the client asks how many to order for a first drop that may not sell out
When the artwork is fussy and must work as one bold shape on fabric
When a mark goes on merch, to test it in one colour and at small size

tasks.task: Check a print file before it goes to the printer

items.when: Just before sending a file, or after a printer rejects one, to catch reprint causes
When the file passes the printer's rules but you doubt it reads at real size
When you build the PDF from a web page and pages break badly or text prints blurry

tasks.task: Plan and batch a month of social graphics

items.when: Once a month, for a client who posts often and wants a consistent feed
When the client has no post plan and you need topics before you design anything
When last month's numbers are in, to see which post formats earned their place

tasks.task: Write or tighten the words for a printed piece

items.when: When the client's words need ranking into what is read first, second and last
When the main line is flat, to get five short headlines that each take a new angle
When the copy will not fit the layout and must lose words without losing the point
When a line sounds like any business, to test it and get a true, picturable rewrite
When the piece is a mailer, to review the envelope line, offer, letter and look

tasks.task: Design a set of static image ads

items.when: Before making images, to set the visual choices and lock the ones that must stay
When you need three or four layouts with text zones and product placement to compare
When the ad needs every word on and around the picture, in two or three versions
When the ad or post is built around a customer's own words
When an ad is drafted, to score it against its page and get fixes

tasks.task: Make Reel, Story and video cover templates

items.when: When the client wants one repeatable cover style with their portrait, title and colours
When you need cover sizes and the area the app's buttons and captions will hide
When a video needs several title and thumbnail pairs to test against each other
Before upload, to check the title length and that the thumbnail does not repeat it

tasks.task: Set colours, fonts and layout rules for a client with no kit

items.when: When the look is undecided, to compare three mood board directions and pick one
When you know the feeling wanted and need a small palette with one job per colour
When the client has no fonts, to compare three pairs with sizes and line spacing
When the choices are made, to write firm rules for colour, type and grid
When the rules are agreed, to give the client a printable brand guide
Before the palette is approved, to check every text and background pair

tasks.task: Draft logo or wordmark directions

items.when: When the client needs several directions, from wordmarks to symbols, with reasons
When the name itself should be the logo, to get five letter-shape ideas
When a direction is picked, to set its colours, file formats and usage rules
When you need a vector draft of the mark that can be scaled and refined
When a mark is busy, to shrink it and cut it to one clear shape
When there are several ideas, to score each and get a keep or drop call

tasks.task: Make or edit images with an AI image tool

items.when: When a piece needs a picture and you want a prompt, the exact size and a file plan
When one image idea should be tried as four different treatments
When you must extend or clean up a photo the client already owns
When you want to explore visual ideas and then reuse the style you chose
When images show people, to check for stereotypes, cloned faces and fake symbols

tasks.task: Make an infographic or a one-page explainer

items.when: Before drawing, to plan which visual pairs with the words so the point sticks
When the content is ready and you need a layout and style picked to fit it
When the piece needs a clean chart drawn from the client's own data
When the page looks like a stock template, to get three hand-made alternatives
When a chart is drafted, to check the chart type and axes do not mislead

tasks.task: Brief an illustrator or photographer

items.when: Before the brief, to agree the tone and feel the artwork must keep
When a photographer or illustrator needs one clear brief for the job
When a photographer needs a shot list with the reason for each shot
When the job is a small icon set, to plan it and test that each icon reads

tasks.task: Plan a van wrap or vehicle livery

items.when: Before layout, to put name, service, phone and web in the order drivers read them
When you need a panel-by-panel spec the wrap printer and installer can follow
Before sign-off, to check the phone number reads from a car's length away

tasks.task: Review an existing design and list the fixes

items.when: When you review any piece, to test contrast, type size and safe areas with exact fixes
When the piece feels cluttered, to trace the eye path and list what to cut
When the piece is mostly text, to check type, spacing and line length
When the piece is a screen or mockup, for hierarchy and consistency feedback
When the piece is tidy but has no voice and could be for anyone

tasks.task: Hand off build notes so someone else can make the file

items.when: When the spec is approved and the owner or another designer will build the final file
When you must check what the client's design tool can and cannot do before writing steps

always.when: Before any work that must match the client's live site: colours, fonts and voice
Before any file goes to print or post, to catch typos and names spelt two ways
When the copy states a number, award or claim you cannot trace to the client

helpers.when: When the piece needs more copy than a headline and a line
When the client has no logo or brand kit and needs an identity, not one piece
When the job includes what to post and when, not only how the posts look
When the piece is a label, box or pouch with barcode and legal panel rules
When the job is a slide deck, a report or a multi-page brochure
When the signs depend on a run sheet or set-up times nobody has planned

gaps: No library item lays out a flyer, brochure or multi-page booklet; only the kit's print layout spec covers it
No library item plans a restaurant or salon menu: sections, dish order and how prices are shown
No library item covers large-format print such as banners, roll-up stands, exhibition stands or window graphics
No library item covers vehicle wraps: panel templates, door and window breaks, or three livery directions to compare
No library item offers different sign styles to compare for one event
No library item checks a print PDF for bleed, colour mode, embedded fonts and image resolution
No library item specs artwork for shirts, totes or caps, or plans a first merch range
No library item covers Pinterest pin layouts or a social template kit a client's team can reuse
No library item checks image, font and stock photo licences before a piece is published
No library item manages client feedback rounds and proof sign-off for a design job
